name: Amakase Minatsu
source:
Hobbies: None
Favorite food: Bananas
Hated food: None

Minatsu is a robot whose model is "HM-A06". However, because of her rich expressions and personality, it is hard to believe the fact that she is not a real human. She manages a detective office by the corner of the shopping street.
